subject: Pricing for workout playlists - Rock, Metal & your top sellers
body:
Hello Jane,

A colleague recommended Chinook. I manage music for PulseFit Studios, a small group of gyms, and we're building new playlists for our classes.

Could you send me a quote for:

- 35 Rock tracks
- 20 Metal tracks
- 15 of your best-selling tracks (any genre)

We haven't bought from you before, so we're probably not in your system. The company name is PulseFit Studios, and this email is the best way to reach me.

We'd like to have the playlists ready by next month, so a quick reply would be great.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Music & Programming Lead, PulseFit Studios
